newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filipino ship passenger throws wife, son overboard.
newsitem.headline: Filipino ship passenger throws wife, son overboard.

text.p: Philippine police on Sunday arrested a passenger of an inter-island ferry for throwing his wife and 10-year-old son overboard.

The wife drowned while the boy was rescued by the crew after the boat turned around to look for them in shark-infested waters off Batangas province south of Manila, police maritime director Alejandro de Guzman said.
De Guzman said the sketchy report he received did not say what provoked the suspect, Belarmino Aquino, to throw his wife and son overboard.
Police said they were preparing murder and attempted murder charges against the husband.
